other_failure_modes.name: Pipeline Misuse / Double Transform
other_failure_modes.description: The agent manually transforms test data using an unfitted preprocessor object that was passed to a Pipeline, and then passes this transformed data into the Pipeline's predict method (which expects raw data). Scikit-learn Pipelines clone their steps upon fitting, so the original preprocessor remains unfitted, causing a NotFittedError. Even if fitted, passing transformed data to the Pipeline would result in a double-transform error.

summary: The agent attempts to build a regression pipeline using LightGBM but fails due to immediate execution errors and severe logical flaws. It forgets to import the 'warnings' module, causing an early crash, and fundamentally misuses scikit-learn's Pipeline by attempting to manually transform data with an unfitted preprocessor before passing it to the pipeline's predict method. Additionally, it skips internal validation entirely and performs no feature engineering.
